B0150.title: HVAC Mode Door Range/Performance
B0150.description: The HVAC control module has detected that the air distribution mode door (e.g. floor/face/defrost) does not reach the commanded position within the expected time. The actuator may be stuck, the door binding, or the position feedback inaccurate.

causes.cause: Wiring or connector fault to actuator

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0152.title: Driver Buckle Switch Circuit Malfunction
B0152.description: The driver seatbelt buckle switch circuit, used to detect whether the belt is fastened, is malfunctioning. The seatbelt warning may be permanently on or off.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0154.title: Passenger Buckle Switch Circuit Malfunction
B0154.description: The passenger seatbelt buckle switch circuit is malfunctioning.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0156.title: Sun Load Sensor Circuit
B0156.description: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the sun load (solar) sensor, typically located on the dashboard. Automatic climate control uses this signal to bias cooling on the side facing the sun.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0158.title: Ambient Air Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0158.description: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the ambient air temperature sensor used by the climate control system. Symptoms include incorrect outside temperature display and erratic automatic climate behavior.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0159.title: Outside Temperature Sensor Range/Performance
B0159.description: The HVAC control module reports an out-of-range or implausible reading from the outside air temperature sensor. The displayed value may be stuck or impossibly high/low.

causes.cause: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0160.title: In-Vehicle Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0160.description: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the in-vehicle temperature sensor — typically an aspirated sensor in the dashboard. Automatic climate control regulates cabin temperature using this signal.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0162.title: Sun Load Sensor 2 Circuit
B0162.description: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the second sun load sensor. Dual-zone systems use two solar sensors to detect side-asymmetric sunlight and adjust left/right airflow temperature.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0164.title: Air Bag In-Vehicle Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0164.description: A fault is detected in the in-vehicle temperature sensor circuit used by the SRS module for deployment compensation.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0166.title: HVAC Discharge Air Temperature Sensor
B0166.description: The HVAC control module reports an implausible signal from the discharge (vent outlet) air temperature sensor. This sensor verifies that the actual outlet air temperature matches the commanded value.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0168.title: HVAC Air Mix Door Performance
B0168.description: The HVAC control module has detected that the air mix (blend) door does not reach the commanded position within the expected time. The blend door regulates the ratio of air through the heater core versus around it.

causes.cause: Blend door mechanically binding or broken

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0170.title: HVAC Mode Door Position Sensor
B0170.description: The HVAC control module reports an implausible position signal from the mode (air distribution) door feedback sensor. Without valid feedback the actuator cannot be regulated to the correct position.

causes.cause: Wiring or connector fault to actuator

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0173.title: HVAC Air Inlet Door
B0173.description: The HVAC control module has detected a fault on the fresh-air/recirculation inlet door — typically a stuck actuator or position feedback out of range.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0175.title: HVAC Recirculation Door Performance
B0175.description: The HVAC control module has detected that the recirculation door does not reach the commanded position within the expected time. The recirc door switches between fresh air and recirculated cabin air.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0181.title: Front Blower Motor Circuit Low
B0181.description: The HVAC control module has detected low voltage or a short to ground in the front blower motor circuit. The blower may run too slow or not at all.

causes.cause: Blower resistor or power module failed

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0182.title: Right Front/Passenger Side Buckle Tension Sensor Circuit
B0182.description: The right front buckle tension sensor circuit is reporting a malfunction.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0184.title: Rear Blower Motor Circuit
B0184.description: The HVAC control module has detected a fault in the rear blower motor circuit, used in vehicles with separate rear climate zones. Symptoms include no rear airflow or rear blower stuck on.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0186.title: Front Blower Motor Speed Performance
B0186.description: The HVAC control module has detected that the front blower motor does not run at the commanded speed. Possible causes include a worn motor, blocked airway, or driver module fault.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0188.title: Rear Wiper Motor Circuit
B0188.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear wiper motor circuit. Possible faults include an open or shorted motor winding, a stuck mechanism, or wiring damage in the tailgate harness.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0190.title: Front Wiper Park Switch Circuit
B0190.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the front wiper park switch circuit. The wipers may not return to the park position when switched off.

causes.cause: Park switch in wiper motor failed

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0192.title: Front Wiper Speed Performance
B0192.description: The body control module has detected that the front wiper does not run at the commanded speed. Possible causes include a worn motor, binding linkage, or excessive load.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0200.title: Air Bag System Voltage Out of Range
B0200.description: The SRS module has detected that its supply voltage is outside the operating range, preventing reliable deployment readiness.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0205.title: HVAC Defroster Door Position
B0205.description: The HVAC control module has detected that the defroster door (windshield air outlet flap) does not reach the commanded position. Defrosting performance may be reduced.

causes.cause: Door actuator motor failed or stripped

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0210.title: Rain Sensor Module
B0210.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the rain sensor module on the windshield. Automatic wiper activation based on moisture detection is no longer available.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0220.title: Front Wiper Motor Speed Circuit
B0220.description: The body control module has detected that the front wiper motor speed feedback does not match the commanded speed. The motor may run only on one speed or not at all.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0223.title: SRS Indicator Lamp Circuit Malfunction
B0223.description: The SRS module has detected a fault in the airbag warning lamp circuit. The lamp may be inoperative, which prevents driver notification of stored faults.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0226.title: Headlamp Auto-Leveling Front Sensor
B0226.description: The body control module reports an implausible signal from the front ride-height sensor used by the automatic headlamp leveling system. Without valid input, the headlamp pitch cannot be corrected for vehicle load.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0228.title: Front Fog Lamp Circuit
B0228.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the front fog lamp circuit — typically an open bulb, blown fuse, or wiring fault. One or both fog lamps may not work.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0231.title: Front Marker Lamp Circuit
B0231.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the front side marker lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state — the bulb may be burned out or the wiring is open.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0233.title: Rear Tail Lamp Circuit
B0233.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear tail lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0235.title: Brake Lamp Circuit
B0235.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the brake lamp circuit. One or more brake lamps do not match the commanded state — a safety-relevant fault.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0237.title: Backup Lamp Circuit
B0237.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the backup (reverse) lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state when reverse gear is engaged.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0239.title: License Plate Lamp Circuit
B0239.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the license plate lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0240.title: Headlamp Switch Circuit
B0240.description: The body control module has detected an implausible state at the headlamp switch — for example simultaneous low and high beam request, or no signal at all. Lighting functions may be erratic.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0245.title: Driver Window Switch Circuit
B0245.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver window switch circuit. The window may not respond to the switch in the driver door.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0247.title: Passenger Window Switch Circuit
B0247.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger window switch circuit. Same fault profile as B0245 but for the passenger window.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0250.title: HVAC Air Temperature Internal Sensor Circuit
B0250.description: The HVAC controller has detected a fault in the internal cabin air temperature sensor circuit, used to regulate climate control output.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0252.title: Driver Window Motor Down Circuit
B0252.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver window motor down-direction control circuit. The window may not lower correctly.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0255.title: HVAC Air Temperature External Sensor Circuit
B0255.description: A fault has been detected in the external (ambient) temperature sensor circuit used by the HVAC and instrument cluster.

causes.cause: Ambient sensor failure (often behind front grille)

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0258.title: HVAC Air Mix Door 1 Circuit
B0258.description: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the actuator circuit for air mix door 1, which controls the proportion of warm and cool air in the airflow.

causes.cause: Air mix door actuator motor failed

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0260.title: Interior Light Circuit
B0260.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the interior light circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state — common cause is a stuck door switch causing battery drain.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0263.title: HVAC Air Mix Door 2 Circuit
B0263.description: A fault has been detected in the air mix door 2 actuator circuit, used in dual-zone HVAC systems for the passenger side.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0265.title: Driver Door Lock/Unlock Switch Circuit
B0265.description: Driver Door Lock/Unlock Switch Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects central locking operated from this switch.

causes.cause: Door harness broken in hinge area

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0268.title: HVAC Mode Door 1 Circuit
B0268.description: The HVAC mode door 1 actuator circuit, which routes airflow between defrost, vents, and floor, has reported a fault.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0270.title: Passenger Door Lock Switch Circuit
B0270.description: Passenger Door Lock Switch Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects central locking operated from this switch.

causes.cause: Door harness broken in hinge area

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0272.title: Power Door Lock Switch Circuit
B0272.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the power door lock switch circuit. Central locking may not respond to the door switch.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0273.title: HVAC Recirculation Door Circuit
B0273.description: The HVAC recirculation door actuator circuit has reported a fault. Fresh/recirculated air switching may not work.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0274.title: Trunk Lid Release Switch Circuit
B0274.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the trunk lid release switch circuit. The trunk may not open via the interior or remote release.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0278.title: HVAC Defrost Door Circuit
B0278.description: A fault is detected in the HVAC defrost door actuator circuit; defrost airflow may not engage.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0283.title: HVAC Blower Motor Circuit
B0283.description: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the blower motor control circuit. Blower may run at incorrect speed or not at all.

causes.cause: Blower resistor or final stage failed

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0288.title: HVAC A/C Pressure Sensor Circuit
B0288.description: A fault has been detected in the A/C refrigerant pressure sensor circuit. The compressor may be disabled to protect the system.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0290.title: Rear Defrost Switch Circuit
B0290.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear window defroster switch circuit. The switch may be stuck or its signal does not reach the module — the rear defroster cannot be activated.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0292.title: HVAC A/C Compressor Clutch Circuit
B0292.description: The HVAC controller has detected a fault in the A/C compressor clutch control circuit. The compressor may not engage.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0300.title: HVAC Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0300.description: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the evaporator temperature sensor circuit, used to prevent evaporator icing.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0305.title: HVAC Sun Load Sensor Circuit
B0305.description: A fault has been detected in the sun load sensor circuit used by automatic climate control to compensate for solar gain.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0310.title: Driver Seat Position Sensor Circuit
B0310.description: Driver Seat Position Sensor Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. The sensor reports seat position for the memory function and SRS occupant logic.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0312.title: Driver Seat Forward/Back Switch Circuit
B0312.description: The seat module has detected a fault in the fore/aft adjustment switch on the driver seat. Manual adjustment of the seat position may be limited or not work at all.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0320.title: Passenger Seat Position Sensor Circuit
B0320.description: Passenger Seat Position Sensor Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. The sensor reports seat position for the memory function and SRS occupant logic.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0322.title: Driver Seat Tilt Position Sensor
B0322.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver seat tilt position sensor. Memory positions for seat back tilt cannot be reliably stored.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0325.title: Driver Seat Memory Set Switch
B0325.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver seat memory set switch circuit. Seat positions cannot be saved to memory presets.

causes.cause: Module software outdated, reflash may resolve

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0327.title: Passenger Seat Position Memory
B0327.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger seat position memory function. Saved positions cannot be reliably restored.

causes.cause: Module software outdated, reflash may resolve

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0330.title: HVAC Rear Blower Motor Circuit
B0330.description: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the rear blower motor circuit, used in vehicles with rear climate zone.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0335.title: Driver Seat Heater Circuit
B0335.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver seat heater circuit. The heating element or wiring is open or shorted — the seat does not heat.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0337.title: Passenger Seat Heater Circuit
B0337.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger seat heater circuit. Same fault profile as B0335 but for the passenger seat.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0339.title: Rear Seat Heater Circuit
B0339.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear seat heater circuit. The rear heating elements are open or shorted.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0341.title: HVAC Heated Seat Driver Circuit
B0341.description: A fault has been detected in the driver heated seat circuit. Seat heating may be disabled.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0342.title: HVAC Heated Seat Passenger Circuit
B0342.description: A fault has been detected in the passenger heated seat circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0420.title: Audio System Internal Failure
B0420.description: The audio head unit reports an internal self-test failure. Symptoms include silent output, frozen display, or repeated reboots of the infotainment system.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0425.title: Audio Amplifier Internal Failure
B0425.description: The audio amplifier reports an internal self-test failure. Sound output may be distorted, missing on some channels, or the amplifier enters a protection mode.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0440.title: Bluetooth Module Fault
B0440.description: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the Bluetooth module. Pairing with phones may fail or audio streaming drops out.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0445.title: USB Hub Fault
B0445.description: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the internal USB hub. USB ports may not detect connected devices reliably.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0450.title: Microphone Circuit
B0450.description: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the hands-free microphone circuit. Voice commands and phone calls may have poor audio quality.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0455.title: Display Module Internal Failure
B0455.description: The instrument cluster or central display module reports an internal self-test failure. Pixels may be missing, the screen may stay dark, or warning indicators may not display correctly.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0460.title: Bluetooth Antenna Circuit
B0460.description: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the Bluetooth antenna circuit. Range and connection stability may be reduced.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0490.title: Display Backlight Circuit
B0490.description: The infotainment or instrument cluster module has detected a fault in the display backlight circuit. The display may stay dark or be unreadable in low light.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0500.title: Driver Power Window Circuit Malfunction
B0500.description: The driver power window motor or switch circuit has reported a fault. The window may not operate.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0501.title: Passenger Power Window Circuit Malfunction
B0501.description: A fault has been detected in the passenger power window circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0502.title: Left Rear Power Window Circuit Malfunction
B0502.description: A fault has been detected in the left rear power window circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0503.title: Right Rear Power Window Circuit Malfunction
B0503.description: A fault has been detected in the right rear power window circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0510.title: Driver Door Open Switch
B0510.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver door open (jamb) switch. The door open state cannot be reliably read — affects interior light, seat belt warning, and remote start interlocks.

causes.cause: Door jamb switch stuck or corroded

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0520.title: Passenger Door Open Switch
B0520.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger door open (jamb) switch. Same fault profile as B0510 but for the passenger door.

causes.cause: Door jamb switch stuck or corroded

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0530.title: Driver Door Lock Actuator Circuit
B0530.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver door lock actuator circuit. Central locking may not work for the driver door.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0531.title: Passenger Door Lock Actuator Circuit
B0531.description: A fault has been detected in the passenger door lock actuator circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0532.title: Left Rear Door Lock Actuator Circuit
B0532.description: A fault has been detected in the left rear door lock actuator circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0533.title: Right Rear Door Lock Actuator Circuit
B0533.description: A fault has been detected in the right rear door lock actuator circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0540.title: Driver Door Ajar Switch Circuit
B0540.description: The driver door ajar switch circuit is reporting an implausible signal. The interior light may stay on or door open warning may be incorrect.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0541.title: Passenger Door Ajar Switch Circuit
B0541.description: The passenger door ajar switch circuit is malfunctioning.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0560.title: Driver Power Seat Forward/Back Circuit
B0560.description: A fault is detected in the forward/back motor circuit of the driver power seat.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0561.title: Driver Power Seat Up/Down Circuit
B0561.description: A fault is detected in the up/down motor circuit of the driver power seat.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0562.title: Driver Power Seat Recline Circuit
B0562.description: A fault is detected in the recline motor circuit of the driver power seat.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0570.title: Passenger Power Seat Forward/Back Circuit
B0570.description: A fault is detected in the forward/back motor circuit of the passenger power seat.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0580.title: Driver Seat Memory Module Malfunction
B0580.description: The driver seat memory module reports an internal fault. Stored seat positions cannot be recalled.

causes.cause: Module software outdated, reflash may resolve

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0600.title: Mirror Adjustment Driver Side Circuit
B0600.description: The driver side mirror adjustment circuit is malfunctioning. Mirror motor or position sensor fault.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0601.title: Mirror Adjustment Passenger Side Circuit
B0601.description: The passenger side mirror adjustment circuit is malfunctioning.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0610.title: Mirror Heater Circuit
B0610.description: A fault has been detected in the heated mirror circuit. Mirrors will not defog.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0700.title: Sunroof Open/Close Circuit
B0700.description: A fault has been detected in the sunroof open/close motor circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0710.title: Sunroof Position Sensor Circuit
B0710.description: A fault is detected in the sunroof position sensor circuit; one-touch and pinch protection may not function.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0800.title: Headlamp Switch Circuit
B0800.description: A fault has been detected in the headlamp switch circuit. Light functions may not switch properly.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0810.title: Left Headlamp Low Beam Circuit
B0810.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the left low beam headlamp circuit. Bulb may be burnt out or wiring shorted.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0811.title: Right Headlamp Low Beam Circuit
B0811.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the right low beam headlamp circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0820.title: Left Headlamp High Beam Circuit
B0820.description: A fault has been detected in the left high beam headlamp circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0821.title: Right Headlamp High Beam Circuit
B0821.description: A fault has been detected in the right high beam headlamp circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0830.title: Left Front Turn Signal Circuit
B0830.description: A fault has been detected in the left front turn signal circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0831.title: Right Front Turn Signal Circuit
B0831.description: A fault has been detected in the right front turn signal circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0840.title: Left Rear Turn Signal Circuit
B0840.description: A fault has been detected in the left rear turn signal circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0841.title: Right Rear Turn Signal Circuit
B0841.description: A fault has been detected in the right rear turn signal circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0850.title: Left Brake Lamp Circuit
B0850.description: A fault has been detected in the left brake lamp circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0851.title: Right Brake Lamp Circuit
B0851.description: A fault has been detected in the right brake lamp circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0860.title: License Plate Lamp Circuit
B0860.description: A fault has been detected in the license plate lamp circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0900.title: Wiper Motor Front Circuit
B0900.description: A fault has been detected in the front wiper motor circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0910.title: Wiper Motor Rear Circuit
B0910.description: A fault has been detected in the rear wiper motor circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0920.title: Washer Pump Circuit
B0920.description: A fault has been detected in the windshield washer pump circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0950.title: Heated Rear Window Circuit
B0950.description: A fault has been detected in the heated rear window circuit. Defrost may not function.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0960.title: Horn Relay Circuit
B0960.description: A fault has been detected in the horn relay control circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0970.title: Interior Light Circuit
B0970.description: A fault has been detected in the interior light circuit.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0980.title: Ignition Switch Run/Start Position Circuit
B0980.description: The body control module reports an implausible signal from the ignition switch run/start position circuit.

causes.cause: Open wire from switch to BCM

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0990.title: Body Control Module Internal Fault
B0990.description: The body control module (BCM) has detected an internal fault and may need to be replaced.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

C0001.title: TCS Control Channel A Valve 1
C0001.description: Fault on traction control system control channel A valve 1.

C0002.title: TCS Control Channel A Valve 2
C0002.description: Fault on traction control system control channel A valve 2.

C0003.title: TCS Control Channel B Valve 1
C0003.description: Fault on traction control system control channel B valve 1.

C0004.title: TCS Control Channel B Valve 2
C0004.description: Fault on traction control system control channel B valve 2.

C0010.title: Left Front Inlet Control
C0010.description: Fault on left front ABS inlet (apply) valve.

C0011.title: Left Front Outlet Control
C0011.description: Fault on left front ABS outlet (release) valve.

C0012.title: Left Front Hydraulic Release Too Long
C0012.description: Hydraulic release on left front wheel circuit took longer than expected.

causes.cause: Outlet valve sluggish or hydraulic restriction

C0014.title: Right Front Inlet Control
C0014.description: Fault on right front ABS inlet (apply) valve.

C0015.title: Right Front Outlet Control
C0015.description: Fault on right front ABS outlet (release) valve.

C0016.title: Right Front Hydraulic Release Too Long
C0016.description: Hydraulic release on right front wheel circuit took longer than expected.

causes.cause: Outlet valve sluggish or hydraulic restriction

C0018.title: Left Rear Inlet Control
C0018.description: Fault on left rear ABS inlet (apply) valve.

C0019.title: Left Rear Outlet Control
C0019.description: Fault on left rear ABS outlet (release) valve.

C001A.title: Left Rear Hydraulic Release Too Long
C001A.description: Hydraulic release on left rear wheel circuit took longer than expected.

causes.cause: Outlet valve sluggish or hydraulic restriction

C001C.title: Right Rear Inlet Control
C001C.description: Fault on right rear ABS inlet (apply) valve.

C001D.title: Right Rear Outlet Control
C001D.description: Fault on right rear ABS outlet (release) valve.

C001E.title: Right Rear Hydraulic Release Too Long
C001E.description: Hydraulic release on right rear wheel circuit took longer than expected.

causes.cause: Outlet valve sluggish or hydraulic restriction

C0020.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit
C0020.description: The ABS control module detects an electrical fault in the pump motor circuit. Without a working pump, the system cannot build hydraulic pressure for ABS or stability control interventions and disables those functions.

causes.cause: Pump motor seized after long inactivity
Pump motor relay welded or open

C0021.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Range/Performance
C0021.description: The pump motor responds, but its current draw or run time is outside the expected range. The control module suspects mechanical wear or hydraulic blockage.

causes.cause: Hydraulic block contaminated with brake fluid debris
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0022.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Low
C0022.description: Voltage on the pump motor control line is below threshold. Typical causes are a short to ground or interrupted positive supply.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0023.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit High
C0023.description: Voltage on the pump motor control line is above the expected range, typically caused by a short to battery voltage or a stuck relay.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0024.title: Brake Pedal Feedback Pressure Solenoid Circuit
C0024.description: Fault on brake pedal feedback pressure solenoid — used in brake-by-wire systems to provide pedal feel.

C0025.title: ABS Pump Motor Stalled
C0025.description: The pump motor draws current but does not rotate. Self-test detects a stalled rotor and disables ABS and stability control.

C0030.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
C0030.description: The signal from the left front wheel speed sensor is implausible relative to the other wheels. Typical causes are excessive air gap, contaminated tone ring or partial sensor failure.

causes.cause: Metal debris on tone ring (magnetic encoder)

C0031.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
C0031.description: Voltage on the left front wheel speed sensor circuit is below the expected range. The fault is typically caused by a short to ground or an open in the supply line.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0032.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
C0032.description: Voltage on the left front wheel speed sensor circuit is above the expected range, typically due to a short to battery voltage.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0033.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0033.description: The control module sees erratic pulses from the left front wheel speed sensor at speed. Common cause is metallic debris on a magnetic encoder or a damaged tone ring.

causes.cause: Tone ring cracked or missing teeth
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0034.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor No Signal
C0034.description: No pulses are received from the left front wheel speed sensor while other wheels report motion. The fault disables ABS and stability control.

C0035.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0035.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the left front wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.cause: Tone ring (reluctor) damaged or contaminated with debris
Wiring break or chafe at wheel arch
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0036.title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0036.description: Intermittent open or short detected on the left front wheel speed sensor circuit. Often caused by chafed wiring or a loose connector.

causes.cause: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0037.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor
C0037.description: Generic fault on left rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0038.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C0038.description: Fault on left rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0039.title: Right Rear Tone Wheel
C0039.description: Fault detected on right rear tone wheel (pulse ring).

C003A.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor
C003A.description: Generic fault on right rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003B.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C003B.description: Fault on right rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003C.title: Rear Tone Wheel
C003C.description: Fault on shared rear tone wheel (single rear sensor on solid axle).

C003D.title: Rear Wheel Speed Sensor
C003D.description: Generic fault on shared rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003E.title: Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Supply
C003E.description: Fault on rear wheel speed sensor supply circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C003F.title: Wheel Speed Sensors Rotation Direction Correlation
C003F.description: Wheel speed sensors disagree on rotation direction — typically detected when reversing. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0040.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0040.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the right front wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.cause: Wiring break or chafe at wheel arch
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0041.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
C0041.description: The right front wheel speed signal is implausible compared with other wheels. Typical causes mirror C0030.

causes.cause: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0042.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
C0042.description: Voltage in the right front wheel speed sensor circuit is below threshold, typically a short to ground.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0043.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
C0043.description: Voltage in the right front wheel speed sensor circuit is above threshold, typically a short to battery.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0044.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0044.description: Erratic pulses on the right front wheel speed sensor at speed. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Encoder ring contaminated with metal debris
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0045.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0045.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.cause: Wiring break or chafe under chassis
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0046.title: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0046.description: Intermittent open or short on the right front wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0047.title: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor
C0047.description: Generic fault on brake booster pressure sensor. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

C0048.title: Brake Booster Travel Sensor
C0048.description: Generic fault on brake booster travel/position sensor. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

C0049.title: Brake Fluid Level
C0049.description: Brake fluid level low — typically detected by reservoir float switch.

causes.cause: Low brake fluid (leak or pad wear)

C004A.title: Brake Lining Wear Sensor
C004A.description: Brake lining wear sensor reports thin pads.

C004B.title: Brake Fluid Level Sensor/Switch Circuit/Open
C004B.description: Open circuit on brake fluid level sensor or switch.

causes.cause: Pin pushed back out of connector body
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor

C004C.title: Brake Booster Motor A Position Sensor Exceeded Learning Limit
C004C.description: Brake booster motor A position sensor learned offset exceeded the allowed range. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

C004D.title: Brake System Pressure Slow Response
C004D.description: Brake system pressure response slower than expected.

C004E.title: Brake System Pressure Control Valve Actuator Stuck
C004E.description: Brake system pressure control valve actuator stuck mechanically.

C004F.title: ABS Control Module Over Temperature
C004F.description: ABS control module exceeded its safe operating temperature.

causes.cause: Thermal overload from extended ABS use

C0050.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0050.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Loss of wheel speed information disables ABS and stability control, and a separate ABS warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.cause: Wiring break or chafe under chassis
Wheel hub bearing with integrated sensor ring failed

C0051.title: Power Steering Position Sensor Performance
C0051.description: The chassis or power steering control module has detected that the steering position signal is implausible compared to vehicle motion. Stability control may be limited because correct yaw and slip-angle calculation depends on a valid steering angle.

causes.cause: Steering angle sensor not calibrated after alignment or repair
Signal path through clock spring degraded

C0052.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
C0052.description: Voltage in the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit is below the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0053.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
C0053.description: Voltage in the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit is above the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0054.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0054.description: Erratic pulses from the left rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0055.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor No Signal
C0055.description: No pulses received from the left rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0056.title: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0056.description: Intermittent open or short on the left rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0060.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit
C0060.description: The ABS control module detects a fault in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. ABS and stability control are deactivated.

C0061.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
C0061.description: The right rear wheel speed signal is implausible compared to the other wheels. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0062.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Low
C0062.description: Voltage in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit is below the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0063.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit High
C0063.description: Voltage in the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit is above the expected range. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

C0064.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0064.description: Erratic pulses from the right rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0065.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor No Signal
C0065.description: No pulses received from the right rear wheel speed sensor. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0066.title: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Intermittent
C0066.description: Intermittent open or short on the right rear wheel speed sensor circuit. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

causes.cause: Connector with intermittent contact under vibration

C0069.title: Yaw Rate/Longitude Sensors
C0069.description: Generic fault on yaw rate/longitudinal acceleration sensor cluster.

C006A.title: Multi-axis Acceleration Sensor
C006A.description: Generic fault on multi-axis acceleration sensor (combines lateral, longitudinal and vertical accelerations).

C006B.title: Stability System Active Too Long
C006B.description: Electronic stability control intervened for an excessive duration.

causes.cause: Extended intervention from low traction or driver behavior

C006C.title: Stability System
C006C.description: Generic fault in electronic stability control system.

C0070.title: Vehicle Speed Sensor Circuit
C0070.description: The chassis controller detects a fault in the dedicated vehicle speed sensor circuit (when present in addition to wheel speed sensors).

C0072.title: Brake Temperature Too High
C0072.description: Brake temperature exceeded safe operating limit — risk of brake fade.

causes.cause: Hard or prolonged braking, mountain descent

C0073.title: Delivered Driving Torque
C0073.description: Engine-delivered driving torque does not match TCS request.

C0074.title: Requested Driving Torque
C0074.description: Driving torque request from TCS rejected or out of range.

C0075.title: Brake Pedal Position Performance
C0075.description: Brake pedal position sensor reading implausible.

C0076.title: PWM for Traction Control
C0076.description: PWM communication signal for traction control faulty.

C0077.title: Low Tire Pressure
C0077.description: Tire pressure monitoring system detected low tire pressure.

C0078.title: Tire Diameter
C0078.description: Detected wheel speed implies tire diameter outside expected range — typically wrong tire size or mismatched tires.

C0079.title: Variable Effort Steering
C0079.description: Generic fault on variable effort steering (VES) system.

C0080.title: Wheel Speed Mismatch (Front Axle)
C0080.description: Front axle wheel speeds differ beyond the plausibility threshold over time. Often caused by mismatched tyre rolling circumference or a partially failing sensor.

causes.cause: Mixed tyre sizes or worn tyre on one side

C0081.title: Wheel Speed Mismatch (Rear Axle)
C0081.description: Rear axle wheel speeds differ beyond the plausibility threshold. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

C0082.title: Brake System Malfunction Indicator
C0082.description: Brake system malfunction indicator circuit fault.

C0084.title: Traction Active Indicator
C0084.description: Traction control active indicator lamp circuit fault.

C0085.title: Traction Disable Indicator
C0085.description: Traction control disable indicator lamp circuit fault.

C0086.title: Vehicle Dynamics Indicator
C0086.description: Vehicle dynamics control indicator lamp circuit fault.

C008A.title: TCS Mode Control
C008A.description: Fault on TCS mode control input (offroad/sport mode etc.).

C0090.title: Hydraulic Brake Pressure Sensor Circuit
C0090.description: The brake pressure sensor in the master cylinder or hydraulic block reports an implausible signal or no signal. The fault disables ABS, stability control and brake assist.

C0091.title: Hydraulic Brake Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
C0091.description: The brake pressure sensor signal is outside the plausibility band relative to pedal application. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

causes.cause: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0092.title: 4WD/AWD Power Transfer Unit Position Sensor B
C0092.description: Fault on 4WD/AWD power transfer unit (PTU) position sensor B.

C0094.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Temperature Sensor
C0094.description: Fault on rear differential unit temperature sensor.

C0095.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A
C0095.description: Fault on rear differential unit actuator A.

C0096.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Data
C0096.description: Rear differential actuator A data implausible or out of range.

C0097.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B
C0097.description: Fault on rear differential unit actuator B.

C0098.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Data
C0098.description: Rear differential actuator B data implausible or out of range.

C0099.title: ABS Control Module Internal Fault
C0099.description: The ABS control module fails its internal self-test (RAM, ROM or processor watchdog). ABS and stability control are disabled.

C009A.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor B
C009A.description: Fault on rear differential actuator A position sensor B.

C009B.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor C
C009B.description: Fault on rear differential actuator A position sensor C.

C009C.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator A Position Sensor Correlation
C009C.description: Position sensors on rear differential actuator A disagree.

C009D.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor A
C009D.description: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor A.

C009E.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor B
C009E.description: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor B.

C009F.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor C
C009F.description: Fault on rear differential actuator B position sensor C.

C00A0.title: 4WD/AWD Rear Differential Unit Actuator B Position Sensor Correlation
C00A0.description: Position sensors on rear differential actuator B disagree.

C00A1.title: Driveline Control Module
C00A1.description: Generic fault on driveline control module.

C00A2.title: Driveline Control Module Power Transfer Unit Control Circuit Driver
C00A2.description: Fault on driveline control module driver for PTU control circuit.

C00A3.title: Driveline Control Module Rear Differential Unit A Control Circuit Driver
C00A3.description: Fault on driveline control module driver for rear differential unit A.

C00A4.title: Driveline Control Module Rear Differential Unit B Control Circuit Driver
C00A4.description: Fault on driveline control module driver for rear differential unit B.

C00A5.title: Driveline Control Module Transfer Case Unit Control Circuit Driver
C00A5.description: Fault on driveline control module driver for transfer case unit.

C00A6.title: 4WD/AWD Transfer Case Unit Actuator
C00A6.description: Fault on transfer case unit actuator.

C00A7.title: 4WD/AWD Transfer Case Unit Actuator Position Sensor A
C00A7.description: Fault on transfer case actuator position sensor A.

C00A8.title: 4WD/AWD Transfer Case Unit Actuator Position Sensor B
C00A8.description: Fault on transfer case actuator position sensor B.

C0110.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Malfunction
C0110.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the hydraulic pump motor circuit. The pump rebuilds brake pressure during ABS regulation — without it, ABS and stability control are disabled.

causes.cause: ABS pump motor failed (worn brushes, seized)
Power supply wiring or fuse fault

C0111.title: ABS Activation Excessively Long
C0111.description: ABS regulation has been active longer than the allowed duration during a single brake event, suggesting a sensor or hydraulic problem.

C0112.title: ABS Activation Frequency Too High
C0112.description: ABS regulation cycles activate more frequently than the plausibility model allows.

C0121.title: Valve Relay Circuit Malfunction
C0121.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the valve relay circuit, which supplies power to the ABS solenoid valves. With this fault, the module cannot energize the valves and ABS is disabled.

causes.cause: Power supply wiring or fuse fault

C0128.title: Low Brake Fluid Indicated
C0128.description: The brake fluid level switch in the master cylinder reservoir reports a low level. ABS and stability control may be deactivated as a precaution.

causes.cause: Worn brake pads (fluid drops as pistons extend)

C0131.title: Master Cylinder Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
C0131.description: The ABS or stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the master cylinder brake pressure sensor. This sensor reports driver brake input and is used by ABS and ESP for control decisions.

causes.cause: Air in brake system causing erratic pressure

C0136.title: Stop Lamp Switch Circuit
C0136.description: The ABS or stability control module sees an implausible brake light switch signal. Stability and brake assist functions can be limited until the fault is cleared.

C0141.title: Left Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit
C0141.description: Left Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.cause: Inlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0146.title: Left Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit
C0146.description: Left Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.cause: Outlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0148.title: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid B Circuit Malfunction
C0148.description: The ABS module has detected an electrical fault in the secondary outlet solenoid for the right front wheel. ABS and stability control are disabled while the fault is active.

causes.cause: Outlet solenoid valve failed (open or shorted)
Internal fault in ABS hydraulic unit

C0151.title: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit
C0151.description: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.cause: Inlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0153.title: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid B Circuit Malfunction
C0153.description: Electrical fault in the secondary inlet solenoid for the right front wheel. Pressure modulation for that wheel is no longer possible and ABS is disabled.

C0156.title: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit
C0156.description: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.cause: Outlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0158.title: Left Rear ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0158.description: Electrical fault in the inlet solenoid for the left rear wheel. ABS is disabled and the warning lamp is illuminated.

C0161.title: ABS/TCS Brake Switch Circuit
C0161.description: The ABS or traction control module has detected an implausible signal from the brake light switch. The switch tells the module whether the driver is braking and is used to inhibit traction control during braking.

causes.cause: Brake light switch failed or misadjusted

C0163.title: Left Rear ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0163.description: Electrical fault in the outlet solenoid for the left rear wheel. ABS pressure release for this wheel is no longer possible.

C0168.title: Right Rear ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0168.description: Electrical fault in the inlet solenoid for the right rear wheel. ABS is disabled while the fault is active.

C0173.title: Right Rear ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0173.description: Electrical fault in the outlet solenoid for the right rear wheel. ABS pressure release for this wheel is no longer possible.

C0185.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Range/Performance
C0185.description: The stability control module has detected that the lateral acceleration sensor signal is out of the expected range or does not match other inertial sensors. ESP and roll-stability functions may be disabled.

causes.cause: Lateral acceleration sensor failed or drifted
Sensor mounting loose or misaligned after body repair

C0186.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Circuit
C0186.description: The stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the lateral acceleration sensor. ESP uses lateral g-force together with yaw rate and steering angle to detect skid conditions — without it, ESP is disabled.

causes.cause: Sensor cluster loose or mounted incorrectly

C0196.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Circuit
C0196.description: The stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the yaw rate sensor. The yaw sensor measures rotation around the vertical axis and is essential for ESP — a fault disables stability control.

causes.cause: Sensor not calibrated after replacement or alignment

C0200.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Front Left Circuit
C0200.description: The ABS control module detects a fault in the inlet/outlet solenoid for the front left brake circuit. The valve is integrated in the hydraulic block; replacement is generally a workshop task.

causes.cause: Internal short to ground in valve block

C0201.title: Brake Fluid Level Switch Circuit
C0201.description: The ABS or brake control module has detected a fault in the brake fluid level switch circuit. A low fluid level indicates a potential leak in the hydraulic system and disables ABS while a separate brake warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.cause: Brake fluid level low (worn pads or hydraulic leak)

C0202.title: Brake Pedal Position Sensor
C0202.description: The chassis or brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the brake pedal position sensor. Modern brake systems use this sensor for brake assist, regenerative braking and adaptive cruise control functions.

C0203.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Front Right Circuit
C0203.description: Fault in the front right ABS solenoid (mirror of C0200).

C0205.title: Stop Lamp Switch Circuit
C0205.description: The ABS or stability control module has detected a fault in the stop lamp switch circuit. The brake light switch tells the module whether the driver is braking and is used to coordinate ABS, traction control and cruise control.

causes.cause: Stop lamp switch failed or misadjusted

C0206.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Rear Left Circuit
C0206.description: Fault in the rear left ABS solenoid valve.

C0209.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Rear Right Circuit
C0209.description: Fault in the rear right ABS solenoid valve.

C0220.title: ABS Valve Block Supply Voltage
C0220.description: Supply voltage to the ABS valve block is out of range, disabling all valve control.

C0225.title: ABS Valve Relay Circuit
C0225.description: The valve relay supplying the ABS solenoids does not respond as commanded.

C0230.title: Brake Pedal Position Sensor Circuit
C0230.description: The brake pedal position sensor reports an implausible signal. Required for brake-by-wire and stability control.

C0234.title: Wheel Speed Sensor Frequency Error
C0234.description: The ABS control module has detected that one of the wheel speed sensor signals has a frequency outside the plausible range, e.g. unrealistically high pulses or signal dropouts at speed. Stability control may be limited.

causes.cause: Tone ring damaged, missing teeth, or contaminated

C0235.title: Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0235.description: The ABS control module has detected an erratic wheel speed sensor signal — sudden jumps or dropouts compared to the other wheels. Typical causes are a damaged tone ring or a loose sensor.

causes.cause: Tone ring damaged or contaminated with metal debris
Wheel speed sensor loose in housing

C0237.title: Loss of Speed Sensor Signal Front Left
C0237.description: The ABS control module has lost the wheel speed signal from the front left wheel during driving. ABS and stability control are disabled because wheel-individual speed information is required for slip detection.

C0238.title: Speed Wheel-to-Wheel Mismatch
C0238.description: The ABS control module has detected an implausible speed difference between wheels that cannot be explained by cornering. This typically points to one suspect sensor, mismatched tyre sizes or a damaged tone ring.

causes.cause: Tyre sizes or wear levels do not match across axles
Tone ring missing teeth on one wheel

C0240.title: Brake Pressure Sensor
C0240.description: The ABS or stability control module has detected a fault in a brake pressure sensor. Pressure information is used by ESP and brake assist to determine driver intent and modulation pressure during regulation.

C0241.title: ABS Warning Lamp Control Circuit
C0241.description: The ABS warning lamp control circuit is shorted or open. The driver may see a permanently lit or non-functional ABS warning lamp.

C0242.title: PCM Indicated ABS Malfunction
C0242.description: The powertrain control module reports a fault that the ABS module must consider (e.g. traction control engine torque request fault).

C0244.title: PWM Brake Pressure Modulation Circuit
C0244.description: The PWM control of the brake pressure modulation valves is faulty.

C0245.title: Wheel Speed Sensor Frequency Mismatch
C0245.description: The ABS control module has detected that the frequency of one wheel speed sensor signal does not match the others under stable driving conditions. This often indicates a tone ring with extra or missing teeth or a sensor with degraded signal quality.

C0246.title: ABS/TCS Control Module Internal Performance
C0246.description: Internal plausibility check of the combined ABS/TCS control module fails.

C0250.title: Power Steering Pump Pressure
C0250.description: The power steering control module has detected an implausible pressure or load signal from the steering pump. On hydraulic systems this may indicate low fluid or a worn pump; on electric systems it may indicate excessive motor load.

causes.cause: Power steering fluid low or contaminated

C0252.title: Pump Motor Ground Circuit Open
C0252.description: The pump motor ground return is open. The motor cannot run, and the system disables ABS and stability control.

causes.cause: Pin pushed back out of connector body

C0258.title: Brake Booster Vacuum Sensor Circuit
C0258.description: The brake booster vacuum sensor reports an implausible signal; brake assist functions are reduced. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

C0265.title: EBCM Relay Circuit
C0265.description: The Electronic Brake Control Module has detected a fault in its main supply relay circuit. Without proper relay supply the EBCM cannot operate the hydraulic unit and ABS as well as stability control are disabled.

causes.cause: Power supply wiring or fuse fault

C0266.title: Active Brake Booster
C0266.description: The brake control module has detected a fault in the active (electric or vacuum-controlled) brake booster. Active boosters are used by emergency brake assist and adaptive cruise control to autonomously build brake pressure.

causes.cause: Active booster motor or solenoid failed
Vacuum supply weak (vacuum pump or hose fault)

C0267.title: Brake Pump Motor Circuit
C0267.description: The ABS or brake control module has detected an electrical fault in the brake pump motor circuit. The pump is used to build brake pressure during ABS, ESP and brake-by-wire operations and a fault disables these functions.

C0268.title: Brake Pump Run Time Exceeded
C0268.description: The brake control module has detected that the brake pump has run longer than the allowed maximum time. This typically indicates the pump cannot reach target pressure due to a hydraulic leak, air in the system or a worn pump.

C0269.title: Brake Vacuum Sensor
C0269.description: The brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the vacuum sensor on the brake booster. Modern systems monitor booster vacuum to ensure brake assist is available, especially with stop-start engines and electric vacuum pumps.

C0273.title: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0273.description: The brake control module has detected an out-of-range or implausible signal from the brake booster pressure sensor. Brake assist and electronic boost functions may be limited.

causes.cause: Wiring or connector fault to sensor

C0277.title: Brake Booster Vacuum Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0277.description: The brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the booster vacuum sensor. Loss of vacuum signal can cause hard pedal and reduced power assist.

causes.cause: Vacuum leak in booster or hose

C0279.title: Brake Booster Boost Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0279.description: The brake control module has detected an electrical fault in the booster boost (assist pressure) sensor circuit. Power-assist regulation may default to a backup strategy.

C0287.title: ESP Performance
C0287.description: The stability control module has detected that overall ESP performance is degraded — typically a plausibility check between yaw rate, lateral acceleration, steering angle and wheel speeds has failed. ESP is deactivated until the root cause is resolved.

causes.cause: Sensor cluster loose or mounted incorrectly

C0288.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Range
C0288.description: The stability control module has detected that the yaw rate sensor signal is outside the plausible range during stable driving. This typically indicates a sensor offset, an incorrect mounting or a degraded sensor element.

C0290.title: Brake Pedal Stroke Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0290.description: The brake control module has detected an out-of-range signal from the brake pedal stroke sensor. Pedal travel information is required for brake assist and electronically boosted braking.

causes.cause: Sensor mounting or pedal linkage misadjusted

C0291.title: Brake Pedal Apply Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0291.description: Electrical fault in the brake pedal apply sensor circuit. The module cannot reliably detect whether the brake pedal is pressed, which affects ABS, ESP and brake assist functions.

C0295.title: Steering Sensor Indicates Bias
C0295.description: The stability control module has detected that the steering wheel position sensor reports a non-zero angle when the vehicle is driving straight. This bias makes ESP intervene incorrectly and the system requires recalibration.

C0300.title: Inlet Valve Front Left Performance
C0300.description: The front left inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected during ABS self-test.

causes.cause: Valve stuck due to brake fluid debris

C0301.title: Air Suspension Compressor Relay
C0301.description: The air suspension control module has detected a fault in the compressor relay circuit. The compressor cannot be energized which prevents the system from refilling the air struts and ride height drops over time.

C0302.title: Outlet Valve Front Left Performance
C0302.description: The front left outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0303.title: Inlet Valve Front Right Performance
C0303.description: The front right inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0304.title: Outlet Valve Front Right Performance
C0304.description: The front right outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0305.title: Inlet Valve Rear Left Performance
C0305.description: The rear left inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0306.title: Ride Height Sensor Front Left
C0306.description: Ride Height Sensor Front Left: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0307.title: Inlet Valve Rear Right Performance
C0307.description: The rear right inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0308.title: Ride Height Sensor Front Right
C0308.description: Ride Height Sensor Front Right: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0309.title: Outlet Valve Rear Right Performance
C0309.description: The rear right outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0310.title: Ride Height Sensor Rear Left
C0310.description: Ride Height Sensor Rear Left: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0312.title: Ride Height Sensor Rear Right
C0312.description: Ride Height Sensor Rear Right: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0317.title: Compressor Relay Circuit
C0317.description: The air suspension control module has detected a circuit fault on the compressor relay output — typically open circuit, short to ground or short to power. Self-levelling is disabled and the vehicle may sit lower than normal.

causes.cause: Compressor motor shorted, dragging supply down

C0327.title: Encoder Motor

causes.cause: Encoder motor failed (worn brushes or seized)

C0374.title: 4WD Drive Coupling

C0376.title: Front Axle Disconnect

C0387.title: Transfer Case Position Sensor

C0388.title: Transfer Case High Range Switch Circuit Malfunction
C0388.description: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible state from the high range (4H) position switch. Range selection in 4WD mode may be limited.

C0389.title: Transfer Case Low Range Switch Circuit Malfunction
C0389.description: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible state from the low range (4L) position switch. Engagement of low range may be inhibited.

C0399.title: 4WD Mode Switch Circuit Malfunction

C0400.title: Traction Control Solenoid Valve Circuit

C0401.title: Traction Control Switch Circuit
C0401.description: The TCS on/off switch reports an implausible state.

C0402.title: Traction Control Lamp Circuit
C0402.description: The TCS indicator lamp control circuit is shorted or open.

C0405.title: Traction Control Active Too Long
C0405.description: TCS regulation has been continuously active longer than allowed, suggesting persistent low-friction conditions or a sensor fault.

C0410.title: Adaptive Cruise Control Sensor Circuit Malfunction

C0420.title: Adaptive Cruise Control Module Internal Performance
