C066D.title: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Sensor
C066D.description: Generic fault on service/park brake chamber pressure sensor — used on air-brake systems with combined service and spring-applied parking brake chamber.

C066E.title: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Too High
C066E.description: Pressure in the service/park brake chamber exceeded safe limit.

C066F.title: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Too Low
C066F.description: Pressure in the service/park brake chamber dropped below required minimum — risk of insufficient braking force.

C0670.title: Electric Park Brake Actuator Left Circuit
C0670.description: The left electric park brake caliper actuator does not respond as commanded.

C0671.title: Electric Park Brake Actuator Right Circuit
C0671.description: The right electric park brake caliper actuator does not respond as commanded.

C0680.title: Electric Park Brake Module Internal Fault
C0680.description: The EPB control module fails its internal self-test and the park brake function may be limited.

C0700.title: Active Steering Module Communication
C0700.description: A communication fault between the chassis control module and the active steering module has been detected. Active steering varies the steering ratio with speed, and a fault disables this assistance and may store secondary codes in other modules.

causes.cause: Power supply or ground fault to module

C0710.title: Steering Position Signal Malfunction
C0710.description: The chassis or stability control module has received an invalid or missing steering position signal — often via the communication bus from the steering control module. ESP, lane assist and electric power steering may be limited.

causes.cause: Steering angle sensor or steering control module failed

C0712.title: Power Steering Position Sensor Range/Performance
C0712.description: The power steering control module has detected that the rack or column position signal is out of range or implausible. Steering assist may be reduced.

causes.cause: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0715.title: Power Steering Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
C0715.description: The power steering module has detected that the hydraulic pressure sensor signal is out of range — relevant for hydraulic and electro-hydraulic systems. Assist regulation may run in fallback mode.

causes.cause: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0720.title: Electric Power Steering Torque Sensor Circuit
C0720.description: The torque sensor in the EPS column or rack reports an electrical fault. Power assist is reduced or disabled.

C0725.title: Electric Power Steering Motor Circuit
C0725.description: The EPS assist motor circuit reports an electrical fault.

causes.cause: Short to ground in motor wiring

C0727.title: Trailer Connector Circuit Malfunction
C0727.description: The chassis or trailer brake module has detected a fault in the trailer wiring connector — for example open lighting circuit or short to ground. Trailer brake and lighting functions may be unavailable.

causes.cause: Short or open in trailer wiring

C0730.title: Electric Power Steering Motor Position Sensor Circuit
C0730.description: The EPS motor position sensor (resolver/Hall) reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0735.title: Electric Power Steering Module Internal Fault
C0735.description: The EPS control module fails its internal self-test. Power assist is disabled.

C0740.title: Electric Power Steering Voltage Supply
C0740.description: The supply voltage to the EPS module is out of range, reducing or disabling power assist.

causes.cause: Battery undervoltage during high steering load

C0745.title: Electric Power Steering Overtemperature Protection
C0745.description: The EPS module has reduced or disabled assistance to protect the motor from overheating, typically after extended low-speed manoeuvring.

C0750.title: Cruise Control Brake Switch
C0750.description: The cruise control or chassis module has detected an implausible signal from the dedicated cruise control brake switch. This switch is independent from the stop lamp switch and disengages cruise control when the driver brakes.

causes.cause: Cruise control brake switch failed or misadjusted

C0784.title: Trailer Brake Force Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0784.description: The integrated trailer brake controller has detected an electrical fault in the brake force sensor circuit. Proportional trailer brake control is disabled — the controller defaults to a manual or fixed-gain mode.

C0800.title: Drive System Voltage Low
C0800.description: The chassis control module has detected that the supply voltage is below the operating threshold required for ABS, ESP or steering systems. Many chassis functions are limited or disabled until the voltage returns to a normal range.

C0805.title: Steering Angle Sensor Calibration
C0805.description: The chassis or stability control module reports that the steering angle sensor has not been calibrated or that the calibration data has been lost. ESP requires a calibrated zero position and is disabled until calibration is performed.

causes.cause: Calibration required after battery disconnect or repair

C0810.title: Air Suspension Compressor Circuit
C0810.description: The air suspension compressor motor circuit reports an electrical fault. Levelling is disabled.

C0815.title: Air Suspension Compressor Overtemperature
C0815.description: The air suspension compressor has been disabled to protect against overheating, typically after a slow leak.

causes.cause: Slow leak in air spring or line

C0820.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Left
C0820.description: The front left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0821.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Right
C0821.description: The front right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0822.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Left
C0822.description: The rear left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0823.title: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Right
C0823.description: The rear right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0825.title: Steering Effort Sensor Range/Performance
C0825.description: The electric power steering module has detected that the torque (effort) sensor signal is out of the expected range. Steering assist is reduced or disabled.

causes.cause: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

C0827.title: Steering Effort Sensor Stuck
C0827.description: The power steering module has detected that the torque sensor signal does not change despite steering input — the sensor appears stuck. Assist is disabled to avoid uncontrolled steering torque.

C0830.title: Steering Wheel Angle Sensor Center Position Not Learned
C0830.description: The chassis control module has not stored a valid center (zero) position for the steering wheel angle sensor. ESP, lane assist and electric power steering may be limited until calibration is performed.

causes.cause: Sensor calibration not performed after replacement

C0840.title: Air Suspension Solenoid Valve Circuit
C0840.description: One of the level control solenoid valves reports an electrical fault. The corresponding axle cannot be levelled.

C0850.title: Active Damping Control Front Left
C0850.description: The front left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0851.title: Active Damping Control Front Right
C0851.description: The front right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0852.title: Active Damping Control Rear Left
C0852.description: The rear left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0853.title: Active Damping Control Rear Right
C0853.description: The rear right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.

C0860.title: Trailer Stability Assist Performance
C0860.description: The trailer stability assist function detects implausible trailer sway response or sensor input.

C0870.title: Adaptive Cruise Control Brake Request Performance
C0870.description: A brake request from adaptive cruise control or AEB cannot be executed within the expected response time.

causes.cause: Hydraulic block slow to build pressure

C0900.title: TPMS Sensor 1 Battery
C0900.description: TPMS Sensor 1 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.

causes.cause: TPMS sensor battery depleted (end of life)

C0901.title: TPMS Sensor 1 Position Performance
C0901.description: The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 1 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.

C0902.title: TPMS Sensor 2 Battery
C0902.description: TPMS Sensor 2 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.

causes.cause: TPMS sensor battery depleted (end of life)

C0903.title: TPMS Sensor 2 Position Performance
C0903.description: The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 2 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.

C0905.title: TPMS Sensor 3 Battery Low
C0905.description: The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 3 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.

C0907.title: TPMS Sensor 4 Battery Low
C0907.description: The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 4 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.

C0910.title: TPMS Receiver Circuit Malfunction
C0910.description: The body or chassis module has detected a fault in the TPMS RF receiver — for example open antenna or internal failure. No tire pressure data can be received.

C0912.title: TPMS Initiator Front Circuit Malfunction
C0912.description: The TPMS module has detected an electrical fault in the front low-frequency initiator (used to wake and locate sensors). Position learning of the front sensors fails.

C0915.title: Active Roll Stabilisation Front Actuator Circuit
C0915.description: The front active anti-roll bar actuator reports an electrical fault.

C0916.title: Active Roll Stabilisation Rear Actuator Circuit
C0916.description: The rear active anti-roll bar actuator reports an electrical fault.

C0920.title: Suspension Control Module Internal Fault
C0920.description: The suspension control module fails its internal self-test. Adaptive damping or air suspension is disabled.

C0950.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Left
C0950.description: The TPMS sensor at the front left wheel does not transmit a valid signal. Indirect TPMS variants raise this when the wheel-speed-based estimation fails for that wheel.

C0951.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Right
C0951.description: The TPMS sensor at the front right wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

C0952.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Left
C0952.description: The TPMS sensor at the rear left wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

C0953.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Right
C0953.description: The TPMS sensor at the rear right wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

C0960.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Module Internal Fault
C0960.description: The tire pressure monitoring module fails its internal self-test.
